name: University of Geneva
description: The University of Geneva is a public university in Geneva that traces its origins to the Academy founded by Jean Calvin in 1559 and has been a full university since 1873. It has nine faculties including sciences, medicine, law, economics and management, and social sciences.
whyIncluded: Its medical degree is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and Switzerland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 280 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: UNIGE 'Estimation du coût de la vie à Genève' (average monthly costs, published for incoming students): housing = rent CHF 600 + electricity/phone CHF 130; food (entretien, alimentation) CHF 600; transport CHF 45 (CHF 70 from age 25); personal = clothing/culture/leisure CHF 250 + study costs CHF 100. Excludes health and accident insurance (from CHF 80) and tuition. UNIGE's own total is about CHF 1,800-1,900 a month; the page is undated and was read in September 2026.

programmes.name: Bachelor en sciences informatiques
programmes.notes: Semester fees CHF 500 x 2 (CHF 65 fixed fees + CHF 435 supervision fees), the same for all students regardless of nationality. The CHF 65 application fee for holders of foreign diplomas is credited against the first semester's fees, so no one-off fee. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in French. Fee page undated; read September 2026. Fee history: UNIGE's Budget 2024 (p. 11), Budget 2025 (p. 9) and Budget 2026 (p. 32), published by the Division comptabilité et gestion financière, each state 'Les taxes universitaires sont fixées à CHF 500 par semestre et par étudiant-e' (CHF 65 taxes fixes + CHF 435 taxes d'encadrement), so 2024-25 (autumn 2024 in Budget 2024, spring 2025 in Budget 2025) and 2025-26 (autumn 2025 in Budget 2025, spring 2026 in Budget 2026) were also CHF 500 x 2 with no other compulsory fee; the Mémento 'Règlement interne relatif aux taxes universitaires et aux émoluments' (ref. 0346, Fr. 500 per semester) has been in force unchanged since 24.08.2021 apart from an unrelated art. 8 amendment on 18.06.2026, and the Grand Conseil rejected PL 13411 (CHF 1,500 per semester for foreign students) on 23 May 2025.

programmes.name: Bachelor en médecine humaine
programmes.notes: Semester fees CHF 500 x 2 (CHF 65 fixed + CHF 435 supervision), the same for all students regardless of nationality. The CHF 65 application fee for holders of foreign diplomas is credited against the first semester's fees, so no one-off fee. 3-year (6 semesters, 180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in French; on its own it does not allow the practice of medicine but gives access to the master's. Places in medicine are capped across Switzerland (swissuniversities registration); the Faculty admits foreign applicants only within those restrictions, so check UNIGE's admission conditions before applying. Université de Genève (Faculté de médecine) is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications; the registrable qualification is the federal diploma taken after the master's.
